Chapter 765: Chapter 39: Fusion of Time and Space (Thanks to the Alliance Hierarch reward from the book friend ‘知人_论世’)_2

“`

As long as the number of lives that fall into the Two-dimensional World is sufficient, this Low-dimensional Space will slowly come to a halt and start a new round of the ‘game’.

These fixed ‘programs’ are imprinted at the very depths of ‘White Paper’ that even the half-meter-tall elder must abide by.

Upon hearing this, Lin Yuan fell into a brief silence.

Actually, escaping Low-dimensional Space isn’t necessarily a good thing for those lives within the Two-dimensional World.

The Witch Emperor and Witch Ancestor, who once commanded great power in the Two-dimensional World, might become extremely feeble in the Main Universe. Though their potential is substantially increased, how many can actually reach that potential?

Just as the half-meter-tall elder said, the majority of lives thrown into nearby Low-dimensional Spaces would die in a short time, and the few who lasted a while longer would also perish.

“Hmm?”

Lin Yuan looked into the distance at that huge scroll and faintly sensed changes occurring within the scroll.

“The flow of time?”

Lin Yuan’s expression was grave, as he felt fluctuations in the flow of time within the scroll becoming tumultuous.

“In order to take away all ‘Understanding of Rules’ from the game participants, they naturally need to be dead,” the half-meter-tall elder rarely explained.

“A hundredfold time flow rate is too slow; I’ll speed it up a bit.”

As soon as the half-meter-tall elder finished speaking, Lin Yuan noticed that the rate of time within the scroll had reached a million to one, ten million to one.

….

Inside the Two-dimensional World.

The Four Divine Kings and many other Myriad Tribes’ Powerhouses witnessed Lin Yuan entering the heavenly gate, which then quickly dissipated.

They each left Heavenly Mountain, waiting for the next time the heavenly gate would open.

Being Eleventh-Rank Life, their aptitude for comprehension was naturally top-notch. After expending vast amounts of time and energy, they had also conceived some methods to extend their lifespan.

Moreover, with the Ancestor Witch’s Thirty Realms and the Forty Realms’ lifespan extension abilities, it wasn’t difficult to survive tens of thousands or even a hundred thousand years.

“Next time the heavenly gate opens, it must be me who enters,” the Four Divine Kings had ample confidence in their heart.

Just then.

The complexion of the Four Divine Kings changed slightly.

Through the ‘coordinates’ of their true bodies outside, they clearly felt the changes in the flow of time within the Two-dimensional World.

From the original hundred to one, it began to skyrocket without limit.

A little over ten minutes in the Main Universe.

Ten thousand years passed within the Two-dimensional World.

The third opening of the heavenly gate arrived.

This time, when the heavenly gate opened, the Four Divine Kings swept all corners and stood in front of the gate.

However, what awaited them was the heavenly gate, immovable.

Ten thousand years.

Twenty thousand years.

Fifty thousand years.

A hundred thousand years.

…

Time and time again, the Four Divine Kings stood in front of the heavenly gate, only to find that they could not push it open, eventually dying as Avatars with great unwillingness in the Two-dimensional World.

…

“What’s going on?”

“Why has this ‘White Paper’ undergone such a change?”

“The difference in the flow of time is so vast?”

Outside, many Ultimate Beings were enraged, especially the Supreme Beings of the Star Alliance and those of the Yu Clan, who had paid a huge price to allow their kin to survive under the hands of Blood Rain.

And they died inside after all?

What then was the price they had paid earlier for?

“Xia Qin, what exactly is happening?” the Supreme Beings of Star Alliance immediately looked at Xia Qin Supreme Being, as the change in the flow of time within the Two-dimensional World of White Paper had occurred after Blood Rain entered.

If they were to say there was no connection at all, the Ultimate Beings present would not believe it.

“How am I supposed to know what’s happening?” Xia Qin Supreme Being shook his head, “After my human Evolver ‘Blood Rain’ entered the heavenly gate, we lost control over the Avatar, suffering a foundational loss.”

Xia Qin Supreme Being quickly made something up.

After all, such a matter cannot be proven; anything goes.

“You don’t really think that a mere Eleventh-Rank Life can control this ‘White Paper,’ do you?” Xia Qin Supreme Being retorted.

Any Ultimate Being could see that the White Paper contained vast energy, certainly well beyond that of an individual Supreme Being.

Otherwise, it wouldn’t have left dozens of Ultimate Beings at a loss for over a hundred years.

“I suspect that this ‘White Paper’ is actually a ‘living being’ with its own will. The fate of all the lives that fall into it is already predetermined,” Xia Qin Supreme Being said.

Ever since hearing some information about this ‘White Paper’ from Lin Yuan, Xia Qin Supreme Being had thought up an explanation.

“A living being?”

The Ultimate Beings glanced at each other.

This speculation was not impossible, especially now that the flow of time within White Paper was actively changing, which clearly signified a will driving this event.

Could that will belong to that human Blood Rain? Blood Rain had just entered the heavenly gate. Moreover, at the level of an Eleventh-Rank Life, the thought of Refining this ‘White Paper’ was nothing short of a fantasy.

…

Inside White Paper.

Lin Yuan watched as tens of thousands, hundreds of thousands of years passed by in the blink of an eye within the huge scroll.

Even for Ultimate Lives that had stepped out of the River of Time, maintaining such an exaggerated ratio in a short time would come at a cost.

Let alone the half-meter-tall elder maintaining the range of time ratio for an entire Two-dimensional World.

Whoosh.

The half-meter-tall elder constantly played with both hands on the huge scroll, with resplendent light emerging from within the scroll which then gathered in the elder’s hands.

Time went by slowly.

In the blink of an eye, more than a month had passed.

Now, in the hands of the half-meter-tall elder, a fist-sized luminous sphere had condensed.

Lin Yuan merely glanced at it from a distance and felt an infinite essence of time and space flowing over it.

“Is that the understanding of the Spatiotemporal Fusion Rules from all the Myriad Tribes’ Powerhouses within the scroll?”

Lin Yuan’s spirit was slightly uplifted,
